svg.aria-label: PAPER devnet: identity is checked at mint and redeem; in between, eUSD moves by confidential transfer with encrypted amounts and every transfer passes the Sentinel hook; the mint's auditor can decrypt an amount and each disclosure is recorded in a public register, effective after 24 hours.
svg.title: How PAPER devnet fits together
svg.text: Identity is checked where money enters and leaves. In between, amounts are encrypted and every transfer passes Sentinel.
